description: .NET for Mac Catalyst / .NET MAUI bindings for the Ant Media WebRTC iOS SDK, built from ant-media/WebRTC-iOS-SDK against a Mac Catalyst build of libwebrtc. Lets a .NET MAUI app publish and play WebRTC streams through an Ant Media Server on macOS. Apple Silicon only. Same API surface as AntMedia.Net.iOS; use AntMedia.Net for one client across all platforms.
title: Mac Catalyst bindings for the Ant Media WebRTC SDK.
